CustomField.description: What fires, if anything, on GtmReadoutController.publishReadout: None / Bell Only / Bell + Task. Plain Text (not Picklist) because GTM_Notification_Settings__c is a Hierarchy Custom Setting and Custom Settings do not support Picklist fields -- the value constraint is enforced at the Apex layer in GtmNotificationSettingsController.setNotificationSettings(), same pattern as GTM_Agent_Settings__c.Chat_Provider__c.
CustomField.label: Published Notification Mode
